title: Kaos Dance Elite
blurb: Kaos Dance Elite offers early learning experiences blending arts with research-based early childhood education for ages 3 to 5 years. Classes run Monday through Thursday from 9 to 11:30 AM at the Olympia location. They also have other classes with specific dress codes for different dance styles.
extraNote: All new students must complete registration forms before first class
